method: merge of five read-only web sweeps (webrtc-platforms, betting-video, tt-leagues, public-ll, venue-legal) plus spot re-fetches; no accounts, purchases or forms
goal: live video of Polymarket-listed tennis/table-tennis matches with glass-to-glass <= 1 s

bands.le_1s_measured_own_footage: <= 1 s measured by others on own-footage setups (not a Polymarket match)

bottom_line.why_not_match: measured: fastest public feed of a Polymarket-listed match (Setka Cup's own WebRTC/WHEP) is a median 12.2 s behind the burned-in arena clock (preliminary; LL-HLS 13.0 s, HLS 19.4 s, YouTube 20.2 s via yt-dlp); sub-second match video is sold only to licensed sportsbooks (A9) or needs a venue camera, which ITF regulations and ticket terms bar for betting/prediction-market use by spectators (A10; TACP binds players and accredited staff, A11) and which private TT leagues allow only with consent (A8); Polymarket US in-app ATP stream is for 'registered' US exchange users, account tier, capture terms and latency unpublished (B2)
bottom_line.own_footage: others measured self-hosted WebRTC at 42 ms local (ind, method not described), ~0.4 s via public relay (ind, stopwatch), 130-740 ms (vendor/consultancy); OUR pipeline is not measured yet; hosted A2-A7 are vendor claims only
bottom_line.cheapest_legal_le_1s_demo: A1 self-hosted WebRTC on own camera, $0, once measured
bottom_line.cheapest_legal_le_1s_real_match: A8 written consent from a private TT rights holder for non-trading research; price: no public source; not tonight
bottom_line.even_le_1s_is_breakeven: break-even video delay 1.09 s IS / 1.01 s OOS (headline reading); 0.34 / 0.30 s (calibrated reading); negative at all V (stamp-noise reading); OOS per-share CI includes 0 even at V = 0
